title: privacy.data_provided (v1) data payload
description: A per-service slice of a data-export bundle. Published by each owning service to its OWN '<service>.events' exchange with routing key 'privacy.data_provided'; consumed by the Control Room which assembles the full export. (ADR-0009.)

service.description: The emitting service name (matches the envelope 'source').

payload.description: This service's portion of the subject's personal data. Service-specific; consumers (Control Room) treat it as opaque content.

at.description: When the slice was produced (RFC3339 UTC).
